SILT#00046: I've found the name of one of the techniques I use to fall asleep. It's called the cognitive shuffle, and the idea is to have the brain cycle through neutral words to prime it for sleep. Very useful for highly active brains, since we give them a mind-numbing task to do as it drifts off
